name: thnn_conv2d
description:
Representative ATen signature (not an exclusive ABI): aten::thnn_conv2d(Tensor self, Tensor weight, SymInt[2] kernel_size, Tensor? bias=None, SymInt[2] stride=[1, 1], SymInt[2] padding=[0, 0]) -> Tensor. The original Gems pytest calls and results define the required contract; support their overloads, keyword arguments, return types and errors. Do not narrow test coverage to this example signature.
Computes 2-D convolution for NCHW input and OIHW weight with groups=1 and dilation=1. kernel_size matches the weight spatial dimensions; stride and padding specify the two spatial axes. An optional per-output-channel bias is added. The output has shape (N, C_out, floor((H + 2*padding[0] - kernel_size[0])/stride[0]) + 1, floor((W + 2*padding[1] - kernel_size[1])/stride[1]) + 1). Tests cover bias present/absent, floating-point value ranges and special values, and gradients with respect to input, weight and optional bias. Preserve autograd for the ordinary overload. The out overload writes into and returns the supplied output tensor; its mutation is separate from the ordinary signature represented by effects below. Invalid shapes, channel/kernel/bias mismatches, nonpositive strides, scalar spatial parameters and unsupported dtypes are checked against the reference by the original tests.
Registered reference signatures:
aten::thnn_conv2d(Tensor self, Tensor weight, SymInt[2] kernel_size, Tensor? bias=None, SymInt[2] stride=[1, 1], SymInt[2] padding=[0, 0]) -> Tensor
aten::thnn_conv2d.out(Tensor self, Tensor weight, SymInt[2] kernel_size, Tensor? bias=None, SymInt[2] stride=[1, 1], SymInt[2] padding=[0, 0], *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!)
